root_cause_label: Guessed answer without researching the task
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent immediately wrote a hardcoded guess ('BAAI/bge-m3') to /app/result.txt without exploring any task files, leaderboard data, or environment, then claimed completion without correction.
t_err_evidence: Step 1: agent runs 'printf "BAAI/bge-m3" > /app/result.txt' as its very first action, with no prior exploration of the environment or the MTEB Scandinavian leaderboard.
t_commit_evidence: Writing the wrong model name to the result file in step 1 locks in the incorrect answer; nothing in step 2 corrects it.
trigger_explanation: The agent committed to an answer (writing BAAI/bge-m3) at the very first step without any prior exploration, verification, or retrieval of leaderboard data, acting on a generic multilingual-model heuristic rather than task-specific evidence.
